title: MAINT: Small refactor + annotations + slightly more test coverage on `vasp_input.py`
body:
This minor MR aims at improving the test coverage on `vasp_input.py`, with small refactor and annotations.

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [x] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/contribute.html)
- [x] [**Doc strings** in code changed in this MR are up to date.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code)
- [x] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/tests.html)
- [~] [**Changes** have been added in `changelog.d` using `scriv`.](https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/ase/development/writing_changelog.html)
- [~] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)
author: yuzie007

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Another minor thing done in this MR is to rename `test_nelect_charge_compitability` and to privatize it. This avoids a misdetection of this function by pytest, and the privatization indicates that this is rather a helper method.

I believe there is not strong argument on this MR and would like to merge it now.
